value.data: Thoughtful design and modern elegance with clean lines and open spaces. Located in Koramangala, South Bangalore.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Residents generally express positive sentiment towards Sobha Infina, praising its prime location, luxurious amenities, quality construction, and the reputable builder. However, some reviews indicate that the apartments can be expensive, and there have been past concerns regarding construction delays and builder issues associated with 'Sterling Infinia', which may or may not directly apply to the current 'Sobha Infina' offerings.
